research_question: When does the Turner thermodynamic prior help or suppress learned RNA pair scores, and is its effect specific to training, inference, or structured decoding?

scope.model_family: single Plan-A member per seed; no R2D or xens2 ensemble inside this 2x2 comparison

shared_initialization.head: FlatDecisionHead(d_z=128, hidden=64, scorer=resnet2d, chunk_size=0)
shared_initialization.source: new head initialized under the arm seed; no historical Plan-A-trained checkpoint
shared_initialization.reason: A Turner-on-trained Plan-A checkpoint would contaminate the train-off trajectory.

training.batch_order: length-bucketed; numpy default_rng((seed, epoch)); identical sequence order required between training arms

objective.pair_recall_note: Omitted in this 2x2 to isolate the prior. Any later recall term must use inside-outside marginals, never independent sigmoid probabilities.

training.primary_checkpoint: fixed terminal step; no external checkpoint selection

train_off.expected_prior_weight: remains at its shared initialized value because it receives no gradient

decode_selection.selection_policy: micro pair-F1, then macro pair-F1, then micro pair-precision; ties broken by lower temperature then lower gamma

metrics.stem_definition: maximal consecutive nested stem, outer pair first, no bulges; exact stem identity
metrics.statistical_comparison: paired per-sequence and per-seed effects with seed-level dispersion; no cross-level F1 ranking

pilot.purpose: single-factor backbone-LR stability diagnosis only; not a production or SOTA decision
required_checks: both arms load the same shared-init SHA256
initial model tensors are identical before applying the training-prior switch
compute ledgers have identical sequence hashes and batch order
both arms complete exactly 9600 steps without validation early stopping or diverge explicitly
train-on and train-off checkpoints differ after optimization
C0/C1 share one checkpoint and C2/C3 share one checkpoint
no NaN, OOM, mask violation, or non-finite inside-outside posterior
decoder parameters are selected on VL0 only

full_matrix_gate.prerequisite: pilot required_checks all PASS and implementation tests committed

primary_endpoint.aggregation: mean over seeds 0/1/2 at the fixed terminal checkpoint
primary_endpoint.seed_direction_rule: all three per-seed macro pair-F1 deltas must be positive; the paired-interval alternative is not invoked for this run
primary_endpoint.forbidden: selecting the best seed, comparing only seed0, or replacing the terminal comparison with a best checkpoint

secondary_endpoint.recall_reporting: micro and macro pair-recall are mandatory for every arm
secondary_endpoint.mixed_evidence_rule: if micro and macro directions disagree, report mixed evidence and never select only the favorable metric

required_comparisons.C2_vs_C1: test whether aligned train-off/inference-off exceeds inference-only Turner removal
required_comparisons.C2_vs_C0: required before any production-candidate discussion; beating only an ablation arm is insufficient
required_comparisons.C2_vs_C3: test whether Turner is suitable as an inference-only remedy
required_comparisons.production_candidate_baseline_rule: C2 mean micro pair-F1 must be no lower than C0 and C2 mean macro pair-F1 must exceed C0
required_comparisons.C0_final_stronger_definition: C0 exceeds C2 on both mean micro and mean macro pair-F1
required_comparisons.shared_conditions: same initialization, data order, training budget, MEA temperature/gamma grids and VL0 selection policy

checkpoint_trajectory.best_checkpoint_rule: a VL0 trajectory-best checkpoint may be reported only for convergence analysis; record its actual unfreeze count and hashes, and never substitute it for the terminal endpoint
required_analyses: whether the C2 advantage expands, remains stable, or disappears with backbone unfreezing
whether stem micro/macro disagreement is concentrated in a few sequences or length buckets
whether C2 only reaches a good checkpoint earlier rather than converging better
whether C0 surpasses C2 after sufficient training

decision_rules.select_aligned_off_candidate: C2 meets the primary endpoint and both stem noninferiority margins; then exactly one frozen external evaluation is allowed
decision_rules.pair_gain_stem_failure: do not select a production route; diagnose pair-to-stem objective mismatch
decision_rules.C0_final_stronger: stop the train-off mainline and attribute the pilot signal to seed or undertraining
decision_rules.seed_direction_inconsistent: do not select a route; inspect training stability and never choose a champion seed
decision_rules.C3_repeatedly_weaker: allow only the limited conclusion that Turner is not suitable as an inference-only remedy in this setting; do not claim universal Turner ineffectiveness

route_interpretation.any_result: requires precision, recall, pair-F1 and stem-F1 jointly; no SOTA or production claim from VL0 alone

external_policy.previous_eight_panels: not used in pilot or route/parameter selection
external_policy.future_use: only if C2 meets the frozen primary endpoint and both stem noninferiority margins, permit exactly one frozen sensitivity application; otherwise none; label any such application non-independent because the panels were used in earlier analyses
external_policy.strict_ood: requires a separate preregistered official/time-out split
